research_notes.finding: Structure: { conversations: [ { id: string, title: string, messages: [ { role: 'user'|'assistant', content: string } ] } ] }

Key check: 'window.crossOriginIsolated' is the most reliable indicator that SharedArrayBuffer can be backed by shared memory. Logic: `const supportsWebContainer = window.crossOriginIsolated && typeof SharedArrayBuffer !== 'undefined';`

architecture_patterns.pattern: Mobile-first approach. Use 'hidden md:block' utility classes or conditional rendering based on isMobile.

technical_notes.note: WebContainer requires COOP/COEP headers. Even if SharedArrayBuffer exists, it might not work if headers are missing. useCapabilityDetection MUST check window.crossOriginIsolated.
MobileCapabilityBanner should be prominent (top of screen or overlay) but dismissible or persistent depending on severity.
For demo mode, ensure we don't accidentally try to boot WebContainer. It crashes on non-isolated contexts.
